title: Paystride Payroll Card Program Agreement: One Program per Employer
content:
**Clause 1. One program per employer.** An employer holds at most 1 Paystride Payroll Card Program; every location and payroll group of the employer funds through it. An employer may not hold a second Paystride Payroll Card Program that is not terminated.

**Clause 2. Opening a program.** A new program opens in contracted status in the package the employer chose, provided its active cardholder count meets that package's entry threshold, with a zero funding balance and zero kit inventory.

### Application of Clause 1

| The employer's existing Paystride Payroll Card Program is | A second program may be opened |
|---|---|
| contracted | no |
| live | no |
| suspended | no |
| terminated | yes — a terminated program does not count against Clause 1 |
| none on record | yes, under Clause 2 |

- The test is read from Paystride's own program records for the same employer, not from the caller's account of what the employer holds.
- A new program is a separate program record with its own signing date; it never reopens a terminated one.
- All of an employer's locations and payroll groups belong to its one program; a location or payroll group is never the basis for a second program.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical employer whose only earlier program is terminated chooses the Select package with 140 active cardholders. The count meets the Select entry threshold, so the new program opens in contracted status with a funding balance of 0.00 and no kits held. Had the earlier program still been suspended, no second program could be opened.
